note: Sanitized public version of the migration manifest. The 2026-09-12 migration moved the RhythmAlign research laboratory out of the product repository into this workspace. Every migrated file was hash-verified on both sides. This public version records relative paths, sizes, SHA-256 digests and categories only; absolute local paths and the product-repo ignored-file inventory remain local-only. Binary categories (audio/video outputs, checkpoints, third_party) are NOT committed to Git; this manifest documents the local artifact inventory so integrity can be re-verified at any time.
